prospect.name: Ryan Bundy
prospect.family_status: Married with two young children, ages five and eight
prospect.training_background: Former athlete (played baseball or football). Jiu-jitsu 2-3x/week, reduced intensity. Kettlebells on and off for about five years — Onnit programme, Pavel Tsatsouline Simple & Sinister, EMOM push-up work. Also mountain biking, skiing, golf, walking.

Blood sugar issues. Currently three weeks into acute digestive inflammation of unknown cause; ultrasound of liver, gallbladder, kidney and pancreas plus blood tests taken two days prior, results due the day of the call; possible gallstones and possible surgery.

signals: Runs a mortgage branch, keeps a business coach of twelve years, sub-10% body fat, explicitly framing gains as 1-2-3% tweaks at his level
'I already have muscle and I build it. I'm not too worried about that.'

goals.text: Keep muscle but hold a lean 'fit look' rather than a bulky one
Be flexible and feel good — move well and get up off the floor without hands into his 50s and 60s
Play the long-term longevity game so he can keep doing jiu-jitsu, golf, biking and skiing
Have his young kids see him fit, strong and disciplined and mimic what he does
Get a protocol with variety that fits around jiu-jitsu instead of piling on injuries
Improve posture — open the chest, build the back, stop the shoulders rolling forward

pains.text: Recurrent injuries from doing too much — trap tweaks, AC joint, herniated disc, upper-thoracic inflammation that shut him down for two months
Three weeks of acute digestive inflammation of unknown cause, awaiting ultrasound and blood test results; possible gallstones and possible surgery
Inconsistent with lifting — on and off with kettlebells for years because jiu-jitsu was taking everything
Cannot tell which of the conflicting protocols to follow; social media gives contradictory answers on training and diet
Recovers far more slowly than he did at 25 but his head still wants to train like it
Under an incredible amount of stress from a move back from Mexico, family matters and work; sleeping badly for months
Simple & Sinister is the only thing that reliably makes him feel good but it is boring, so he drifts off it

objections.raw_quote: So I have a doctor's appointment today. I'm, I've had some gut issues and I need to go like, I gotta like, so I want to make sure before I start that I'm getting healthy. I have some inflammation. That's why I was, you probably didn't get this, but texting, I was texting with somebody, I go, look, I'm holding off on this until I get through these tests.
objections.rep_response: Accepted the hold without pushing. Offered to enrol him anyway and start with mobility work only, said the programme could be paused if surgery were needed, then attributed the gut symptoms to stress, alcohol and poor sleep and booked a follow-up call for Friday.

objections.raw_quote: I like it. I mean, I mean, I like it. I just want to make sure it's not something crazy, ridiculous price. got some guitar lessons, they were going to charge me $10,000 for three months, you know
objections.rep_response: Joked '100k, that's it', then stated the real tiers: 12 months $9,000, 6 months $6,000, with a $3,000 top-up if he extends after six months.

offer.payment_plan_terms: Rep volunteered unprompted that upfront payment might not be necessary in his case — 'That depends. Like most guys take it upfront. Um, maybe in your case, it's, it's not a necessity' — but no structure, amounts or schedule were discussed.

evidence: Prospect explicitly gated the decision on pending diagnostics: 'I want to make sure that I'm not putting money down until I get, I think I'm going to meet with them today.'
Positive intent stated: 'I wouldn't be on this call if I wasn't seriously considering this' and 'if it's something that we can, that I don't need to have a surgery... Then I'll probably do this.'
Follow-up call agreed for Friday 11am Pacific on the same link: 'All right, cool. I'll prepare the meeting. It's going to be the same link.'
Counter-evidence: no payment link, no deposit, no verbal agreement to buy; the outcome depends entirely on an ultrasound result the rep has no visibility into.
outcome.next_step: Follow-up call Friday 11am Pacific, after the prospect receives ultrasound and blood test results.

notable.note: The prospect is mid-diagnostic-workup for possible gallstones and possible surgery, and the rep responded by offering to enrol him now and start mobility work, plus an unprompted hint that upfront payment might not be required. The rep also gave a confident causal explanation for the prospect's undiagnosed abdominal symptoms (stress, beer, poor sleep, unprocessed emotion) while ultrasound results were still pending. Separately, the recording opens with roughly one minute of a different prospect, Nikhil, whose call was double-booked and rescheduled off-camera — that interaction exists nowhere else in the corpus.
